entries.title: Job 12:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: 1 Job maintains himself against his friends that reprove him. 7 He acknowledges the general doctrine of God's omnipotence.

entries.title: Job 12:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: But I have. 13:2-5; Pr 26:4; 2Co 11:5,21-23 understanding. Heb. an heart. I am not inferior to you.Heb. I fall not lower than you. who knoweth not such things as these. Heb. with whom are not such as these. 6:6,7; 26:2,3

entries.title: Job 12:10
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: whose hand. Nu 16:22; Da 5:23; Ac 17:25,28 soul. or, life. the breath. 27:3; 34:14,15; Ge 2:7; 6:17; Ps 104:29; 146:3,4 mankind. Heb. flesh of man. Joh 3:6

entries.title: Job 12:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: he breaketh. 9:12,13; 11:10; Isa 14:23; Jer 51:58,64; Mal 1:4 he shutteth. 16:11; 1Sa 17:46; 24:18; 26:8; *marg: Isa 22:22; Ro 11:32; *marg: Re 3:7 up. Heb. upon.

entries.title: Job 12:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the speech of the trusty. Heb. the lip of the faithful. Pr 10:21; 12:19,22 taketh. 24; 17:4; 32:9; 39:17; Isa 3:1-3

entries.title: Job 12:21
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: poureth. Ex 8:2; 16:24; 1Ki 21:23,24; 2Ki 9:26,34-37; Ps 107:40; Isa 23:9 Isa 24:21,22; 37:38; Da 2:21,22; 4:32,33; Mt 2:12,13; Ac 12:23 weakened the strength of the mighty. or, looseth the girdleof the strong. Isa 5:27; 11:5; 22:21; Eph 6:10,14

entries.title: Job 12:23
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: increaseth. Ex 1:7,20; Ps 107:38; Isa 9:3; 26:15; 27:6; 51:2; 60:22; Jer 30:19 Jer 33:22; Zec 10:8 straiteneth them again. Heb. leadeth in.

entries.title: Job 12:24
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: He taketh. 20; 17:4; Isa 6:9,10; 19:1; Da 4:16,33; Ho 7:11 and causeth. Ps 107:4,40 in a wilderness{Bethohoo,} "in chaos," i.e., in a state of utter confusion; it is the same word which is employed in Ge 1:2, to describe the chaotic state of the earth at the creation.

entries.title: Job 12:25
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: grope. 5:14; Ge 19:11; De 28:29; Isa 59:10; Ac 13:11; 1Jo 2:11 maketh. Ps 107:27; Isa 19:14; 24:20 stagger. Heb. wander.
